fees_note: Read on RoverPass: one night, site rate before tax, every RV rate a 23-ft rig fits (Full Hook Up 30/50 Amp RV Sites). October 2026, January 2027 and June 2027: $60, Tuesday and Saturday alike. RoverPass adds its own $3.50 platform fee at checkout, and a card processing fee. Read 2026-10-14.
note: RV park at 450 Old Dutchman Road, Smith Point, on Galveston Bay, with a boat ramp and dock and bank fishing: 37 full-hookup 30/50-amp sites for rigs up to 40 ft, pull-throughs among them.  There are air-conditioned bathrooms and showers and a laundry, ice is sold, and shade is limited; the gate closes at 7 p.m., so a later arrival must be arranged. --Claude

name: Sandpipers Nudist Resort
fees_note: Nudist resort: full hookup $70-75 with electric and grounds fees (AANR members $65).
note: Clothing-optional (nudist, AANR-affiliated) RV resort in Edinburg; 115+ extra-wide concrete full-hookup pull-through sites, 30/50-amp, RVs to ~73 ft, pool/hot tubs. Winter-Texan seasonal but operates year-round; call ahead / registration required (not set up for drop-in day visitors). --Claude

name: Sea Breeze RV Resort
fees_note: Daily $80-85.
note: Bayfront RV resort on Corpus Christi/Nueces Bay in Portland (est. 1994); full-hookup sites incl. bay-view rows, private lighted fishing pier, heated pool/hot tub, clubhouse. Daily $80-85 / weekly rates - transient-bookable. --Claude

name: Shady Acres RV Park
fees_note: $60 nightly.
note: Small transient RV park in Perryton (Texas Panhandle) with full-hookup (30/50A) sites, nightly ~$60 / weekly $275, laundry and WiFi; sits among oilfield/industrial yards but presents as a general small-town RV park with shade trees. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Shallow Creek Golf & RV Resort
fees_note: $55 nightly.
note: 63 oversized full-hookup (50-amp) sites in the Piney Woods between Kilgore and Gladewater off I-20; 100% concrete roads/pads, clubhouse, pool, hot tub, stocked fishing pond, on-site golf. Nightly transient bookable via operator/Good Sam/RoverPass (Coast-to-Coast affiliated but publicly bookable). --Claude

name: Southern Oaks Luxury RV Resort
fees_note: All site types $70 daily, effective Oct 1 2026.
note: Gated private RV resort at 1850 Hwy 35 Bypass in Aransas Pass (Coastal Bend near Corpus Christi). Oversized concrete pull-through/back-in pads with 30/50 amp, full hookups, high-speed internet; heated saltwater pool, spa, pickleball, dog park, and four stocked fishing ponds on site. Nightly/weekly/monthly. --Claude

name: Taylor Oaks RV Park
fees_note: All sites $55, everything included.
note: In-town Rockport RV park (est. 1960), 60 level sites with concrete patios, full hookups (30/50/110 amp), cable/WiFi/water/sewer/trash; daily rate $55 (transient) plus weekly/monthly. Blocks from downtown art district, ~1 mi to Rockport city beach. --Claude

name: Terry's Country RV Park
fees_note: The Campspot marketplace, one night for 2 adults from a Tuesday (2026-11-10) and from a Saturday (2026-11-14), site rate before tax: Full Hookup RV Site $55; Fenced Full Hookup RV Site $65. Plus the park's $5 campground fee, once per stay. Read 2026-10-13.
note: RV park on 40 acres at 10050 E FM 1462, Alvin, opened in 2020: gated, with security cameras, fishing ponds and tent sites too.  Rated 4.8 on Google. --Claude

name: Timber Ridge RV Village
fees_note: Read on the Campspot marketplace: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (STANDARD, PREFERRED and PREMIUM). October 2026: $55-70, Tuesday and Saturday alike. June 2027 isn't open for booking yet. Read 2026-10-13.
note: Small RV park on FM 2978 near Magnolia, northwest of Houston, with two stocked fishing ponds, shady sites and cable TV, for nightly, weekly or monthly stays. --Claude

name: Top of the Hill RV Resort
fees_note: $65 for 2 adults.
note: Private Hill Country RV resort on a tiered mesa near I-10, ~30 min from San Antonio; 103 full-hookup sites (30/50-amp), big-rig accessible pull-throughs, plus cabins and a few tent sites. Pool/spa, clubhouse, fitness room, general store, laundry. Nightly reservable (RoverPass/operator). --Claude

name: Wagon Master RV Park & Alpaca Farm
fees_note: Read on CampLife: one night, site rate before tax, every RV site a 23-ft rig fits (PII- Pull Through and Pull Through). October 2026, January 2027 and June 2027: $65, Tuesday and Saturday alike. An online booking adds $3.50 once a stay. Read 2026-10-14. The park's own fee page lists the same $65 a night for 2 adults, plus $3 a night for each extra adult.
note: Private RV park and alpaca farm at 3926 FM 455 W in Sanger, just north of Denton: big shaded full-hookup sites, all at least 70 ft long and 35 ft wide, with 20/30/50-amp power, 21 covered sites, a large pool, the Wander Inn community center, laundry and free Wi-Fi.  Guests can hand-feed the alpacas. --Claude

name: Willis RV Resort
fees_note: Back-in from $60.
note: Private ~20-acre RV resort near Lake Conroe in Willis, ~45 mi N of Houston. 171 paved full-hookup 30/50-amp sites with 30-ft-wide interior roads, two on-site creeks and a small pond, heated pool/hot tub, dog park; welcomes short- and long-term stays. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Slow Play RV Park
fees_note: From the park's rates page (read 2026-10-13): full-hookup RV sites start at $52 a night and $330 a week, and long-term sites at $695 a month with electricity billed separately.  The park books through ResNexus; its Campspot listing no longer exists.
note: Large RV park, formerly Circle B, on US 70 at Ruidoso Downs, with more than 120 spaces, paved roads and room for big rigs, about 2 miles from the racetrack and near the Lincoln National Forest; it also rents long-term sites by the month. --Claude

name: Rainbow Lake Cabin & RV Resort
fees_note: RV sites from $55.
note: Private mountain RV resort in Carrizo Canyon SW of Ruidoso (operating since 1951). Full-hookup 30/50-amp RV sites (fits rigs to ~45 ft) plus cabins under fir and ponderosa pines along Carrizo Creek, adjacent to Lincoln NF trails. Nightly, reservable. --Claude

name: Bonnie & Clyde's Cool Pines RV Park
fees_note: $58 plus tax with water, sewer, electric and wifi.
note: Private RV park on 15 wooded acres along US-82 in Mayhill (formerly Cool Pines, est. 1998; renamed 2024). 77 RV sites plus 4 cabins, all 30/50-amp full hookups (water/sewer/WiFi), open year-round; nightly/weekly/monthly, reservable by phone. --Claude

name: Camp Rio
fees_note: Standard 30A RV sites $55, premium $60, 50A full-hookup $75, gazebo site $95 (host prices; Hipcamp adds a service fee).
note: Private riverside campground E of Cloudcroft in Lincoln NF (~6,600 ft) on the spring-fed Rio Penasco; full-hookup 30/50-amp RV sites plus Riverside & Mountain View tent areas and cabins/glamping. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Inn of the Mountain Gods RV Park (Mescalero Big Game Hunts)
fees_note: Inn of the Mountain Gods hunting lodge RV park: $55 a day, $350 a week; reservations by phone. Read 2026-10-15.
note: Tribal-run (Mescalero Apache) RV park at the Big Game hunting lodge ~1 mi south of the casino — a real RV park, not the casino lot. ~19 drive-in sites (1-10 back to meadow, 11-19 pull-through) with full hookups, level pads, WiFi, meadow/wildlife views; no showers/laundry; plus a dry overflow lot. Reserve by phone; ~$25-35/night. --Claude

name: Fernbrook Resort
fees_note: Serviced overnight site $90; long weekend $360.
note: 50-acre wooded family resort near Freelton with a private lake, indoor + outdoor pools; 5 transient overnight RV sites (electric + water, 30-amp, to ~35 ft) alongside 95 full-season sites and hotel rooms. Not a membership park. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Pine Valley Park
fees_note: From, plus HST, 2 adults + 3 kids: 30A + water $80, with sewer $85; holiday weekends 3-night minimum.
note: Family campground at 955 Valens Rd near Branchton/Cambridge; 225 seasonal + 35 overnight big-rig-friendly sites with full hookups (electric/water), dump station, propane, laundry, large pool, fishing pond. Reservable online or by phone. --Claude

name: Bear Lake North RV Park
fees_note: Full-hookup standard and RV Plus sites $60, premium $100; 2027 standard $65, premium $110.
note: Full-service private RV park in the town of St. Charles, ~1.5 mi W of Bear Lake (5-min drive to the state-park beach). 22 pull-through + 11 back-in sites with water/sewer/30A (5 w/50A), plus tent sites, 3 cabins, laundry & showers; big-rig access. Reservable. --Claude

name: Wagon Wheel RV Park
fees_note: Read on the Campspot marketplace: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (Flex Full Hookup Back-in). October 2026: $59, Tuesday and Saturday alike. January 2027 and June 2027 aren't open for booking yet. Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout (3%, at least $3). Read 2026-10-13. The park's own page gives a nightly rate of $55, where Campspot charged $59; monthly rates are also offered.
note: Quiet, tree-shaded RV park in Mountain Home, 35 minutes from Boise and close to I-84, with private sites among mature trees; it takes overnighters as well as contract workers and longer-term guests.  Campspot lists its bathrooms, showers and laundry as seasonal.  The 2.5-mile Greenbelt is nearby, and the Mountain Home Golf Course is a block away. --Claude

name: Yellowstone Golf Resort at Aspen Acres RV Park
fees_note: Yellowstone Golf Resort: full hookups $65 a night, $395 a week; tents $25. Read 2026-10-15.
note: RV park at the Aspen Acres golf resort on a 100-acre homestead near Ashton, between Yellowstone and the Tetons; full hookups (50 amp, water, sewer), fire rings, tents welcome, accommodates RVs up to 45 ft; ~$40-60/night. --Claude

name: Arrowhead RV Park
fees_note: Read on the Campspot marketplace: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (Full Hook Up 30 Amp Back-in, Full Hook Up 50 Amp Back-in, Full Hook Up 50 Amp Pull-Through, Waterfront 30-Amp Back-in and Waterfront 50-Amp Pull-Through). The park's rates page lists the same $65-85 a night plus tax, $80-85 for a waterfront site, with 15% off stays of 7 nights or more and a military and first-responder discount (promo code 'Military').  Its 2026 season ran from May 1 to October 13; Campspot also sold October 2026 and January 2027 nights, which are left out.
note: RV park on the Payette River in Cascade whose sites have cement pads and picnic tables; not every site has a fire pit, but a community fire pit by the river comes with firewood.  It has a nature trail, a dog park, pickleball, horseshoes and a remodeled rec room, and the store sells firewood, ice, snacks, basic RV parts and propane refills.  Guests can learn to carve a totem pole or take classes from onsite artisans.  It also has rustic cabins, yurts and tent sites. --Claude

name: Water's Edge RV Resort
fees_note: Read on the Campspot marketplace: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (30 Amp Pull-Through RV Site, 50 Amp Pull-Through RV Site, Back In RV Site With Tent, Waterfront Pull-Through RV Site and Pine Lane). June 2027: $59.27-74.26 on a Tuesday; $60.86-76.24 on a Saturday. Campspot offers no sites in October 2026 and January 2027. Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout (3%, at least $3). Read 2026-10-13.
note: Family RV park on the Payette River in Cascade, within a mile of Lake Cascade, started in 1992 and now run by the founders' daughter and her husband; it serves free cinnamon rolls by the river on Saturday mornings and has a private barbecue area and fire pit, free kayak use and cabins to rent. --Claude

name: Antelope Valley RV Park
fees_note: 30/50A RV sites from $55.
note: Private RV park on a 5.44-acre tree-shaded lot at 776 W Hwy 50 in Delta. Full hookups at every site (30/50 amp, water/sewer), free showers, laundry, grass area with pavilion/fire pits/grill, two dog parks. ~2 mi from Gunnison Bend Reservoir (fishing/boating). Reservable online. --Claude

name: Golden Spike RV Park
fees_note: 30/50A full hookup $64 daily, $69 weekends (Fri-Sun), holidays $74.
note: In-town commercial RV park at 905 W 1075 S, Brigham City, ~1 mi east of the I-15/US-91 interchange. 60 sites: 38 full-hookup pull-throughs (20/30/50-amp, water, sewer), plus tent sites; accepts big rigs to ~70 ft. Dump station, laundry, showers, propane, cable/wifi, playground. Reservable, open all year. --Claude

name: Woodland Shores RV Park
fees_note: Nightly $67 plus tax for 2 adults.
note: Private RV park on the Lewis River in Woodland (I-5 exit 21); 57 full-hookup sites (50-amp), 13 slide-out pull-throughs, big-rig friendly to ~60 ft, game room, laundry, dump station. Reservable. --Claude

name: American Sunset RV & Tent Resort
fees_note: Read on the Campspot marketplace: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (Full Hookup RV Site). October 2026 and January 2027: $60, Tuesday and Saturday alike. June 2027: $74, Tuesday and Saturday alike. Left out: Single Tent Site in RV Section-Winter/Summer Use (sites under 23 ft). Plus the park's $3.50 'Online Booking Fee', once per stay. Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout (3%, at least $3). Read 2026-10-13.
note: Family-owned RV and tent resort in the heart of Westport, close to the beaches, parks, restaurants, shops, marina and docks; it has a 2,400 sq ft clubhouse to rent, a secluded tent area, three rental cabins, a fish-cleaning station, a heated outdoor pool, horseshoe pits, a playground and campfire containers, and sells propane, ice and firewood.  A special monthly rate is available on request. --Claude

name: Screamin' Eagle Campground
fees_note: RV sites with electric + water $55 for 4 people; tents $40.
note: Small private campground at 17 2nd Ave in Ocean City, ~3 mi from Ocean Shores. 10 RV sites with water/electric hookups (all fit a 36-ft rig except site 11), tent/car sites, a primitive cabin, plus horse corrals/stalls - a general campground that also welcomes horses, riding to the beach without crossing a highway. Transient nightly camping, reservable online. --Claude

name: Sand Castle RV Park
fees_note: Full hookup with cable $66.48 tax included.
note: Private drive-in RV park at 1100 Pacific Ave N in Long Beach, a few blocks east of the Pacific Ocean beach approach. Full hookups (electric/water/sewer), WiFi, showers, fire pits; also allows tents. Big rigs accepted though sites are close together. Reservations by phone. --Claude

name: Wildwood RV Park
fees_note: 2026 before tax: water + electric $65, full hookup $77; no hookups $45; military/law-enforcement $5 off.
note: Private RVs-only park at 5415 Sandridge Rd on the Long Beach Peninsula (no tent camping). Sites for rigs up to 50 ft with 30-amp electric, water and sewer hookups, WiFi; campfires allowed. Reservations (75% deposit) by phone/email. --Claude

name: Bellingham RV Park
fees_note: $61.22 plus tax year round; June-September Fri and Sat $5 more.
note: Family-owned transient RV park just off I-5 at Bennett Dr in Bellingham; 56 full-hookup pull-through sites (30/50-amp, water, sewer), big-rig friendly (any size rig), laundry, dump station, WiFi. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Clackamas River RV Park
fees_note: Overnight $65 with tax (rates as of April 1, 2025).
note: 70-acre gated RV park at 40505 SE Hwy 224, ~6.5 mi E of Estacada beside the North Fork Reservoir on the Clackamas River, next to Mt. Hood NF. Big-rig-friendly pull-thru sites, full hookups (30/50 amp), RVs to 50 ft; showers, laundry, 120-seat rec hall. Reservable. --Claude

name: Pacific Pines RV Park & Storage
fees_note: Daily $65.55 ($59 Good Sam) for 2.
note: In-town RV park at 4044 Hwy 101 in Florence on the central Oregon coast. 64 sites incl. full-service pull-thru, back-in and nose-in, each with 50/30/20 amp, Wi-Fi and cable; rec room, showers, 24-hr laundry, fenced pet area. Walkable to Old Town Florence. Reservable. --Claude

name: Steens Mountain Wilderness Resort
fees_note: Read on the Campspot marketplace: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (30 Amp Full Hookup RV Site and 50 Amp Full Hookup RV Site). October 2026: $57-64, Tuesday and Saturday alike. June 2027 isn't open for booking yet. Plus the park's $5 'Online Service Fee', once per stay. Read 2026-10-13. The resort's own page says it remains open year-round, with winter office hours, while Campspot shows it closed from December 1, 2026 through February 2027, as it was in January and February 2026.
note: High-desert resort on 16 acres at Frenchglen, surrounded by the Malheur National Wildlife Refuge and its marshes; it has 38 RV sites, 14 grass-and-shade tent sites and seven lodging options, from cabins to the two-bedroom Homestead.  EV charging is offered only at site 39, by advance reservation.  A two-night minimum applies over Memorial Day weekend, the 4th of July, the Steens Rim Run, the Frenchglen Jamboree and Labor Day weekend.  Frenchglen's small mercantile, gas station and restaurant are typically open from mid-March through October.  Cell service is limited, and the Wi-Fi is meant for email and browsing, not streaming; mosquitoes can be prevalent in late spring and early summer. --Claude

name: On the River Golf & RV Resort
fees_note: On the River: $60 a night for 4, $300 a week. Read 2026-10-15.
note: Transient RV resort on a bend of the South Umpqua River at Myrtle Creek with an on-site par-3 golf course; 44 full-hookup sites incl. 14 big-rig pull-thrus, nightly/weekly rates (~$40-60/night), showers/laundry/WiFi, catch-and-release pond. --Claude

name: Umpqua Riverfront RV Park & Boat Ramp
fees_note: Full hookup $100 for 4, premium spaces $125 for 6; dry camping $75.
note: Transient RV park on the Umpqua River off Hwy 138 W (between mileposts 8-9), west of Oakland/Sutherlin; 20 pull-thru riverfront full-hookup spaces plus 6 dry sites and a boat ramp, pavilion, showers/laundry. Seasonal; currently reopening after site improvements. Reservable/call. --Claude

name: Holiday RV Park
fees_note: Full hookup with cable $60.50 a day including tax AND the Good Sam/AAA/AARP/military discount (effective 7/1/2025); no tents.
note: Private RV park in Phoenix, OR (Rogue Valley, 3 mi S of Medford). 110 full-hookup sites, ~100 pull-throughs with water/sewer/electric/cable/wifi, pool, restrooms/showers, laundry. Transient-oriented (mostly pull-through); reservable by phone/email. --Claude

name: Walker River Resort
fees_note: Power + water $70-76, full hookup $72-82; 3-night minimum on major holiday weekends.
note: RV resort at 700 Hudson Way, Smith Valley, on the West Walker River at the old Hudson townsite (Wilson Canyon). ~130 RV sites, large shaded pull-through and back-in with full hookups + individual picnic tables, plus 5 cottages; pool/hot tub, shooting/skeet range, river access for fishing/swimming, fly fishing (operator site). Transient nightly. --Claude

name: Queen Mine RV Park
fees_note: $55 for 2 ($50 cash or check).
note: Small in-town RV park (25 sites), the only RV park in historic Bisbee — walking distance to Old Bisbee, next to the Queen Mine tour. Level gravel back-ins that take larger rigs, full hookups with 30-amp, restrooms/showers/laundry. Reservations by phone; fills nightly in season. --Claude

name: De Anza RV Resort
fees_note: In season: back-in $75, pull-through $85; lower off season (April 15-Oct 15).
note: Large gated RV resort at Amado (south of Green Valley/Tucson), ~186 full-hookup 30/50-amp sites with pull-thrus and big-rig access, clubhouse/pool/spa. Open to all ages (not 55+ per reviews); accepts nightly/daily transient stays from ~$36. --Claude

name: Rancho Sonora Inn & RV Park
fees_note: Rancho Sonora from January 1, 2026: $65 a night plus tax ($65 deposit); $80 during Country Thunder in April; 3% card fee. Read 2026-10-15.
note: Rancho Sonora Inn & RV Park on Hwy 79 (Pinal Pioneer Parkway) midway between Phoenix and Tucson; ~85 full-hookup sites (30/50-amp) with big-rig pull-thrus, pool and hot tub; takes nightly transient stays ($65/night) as well as monthly. No 55+/age restriction. --Claude

name: Red Barn RV Park & Campground
fees_note: Red Barn: RV sites from $55 a night; tents $25. Read 2026-10-15.
note: Small all-ages transient RV park just off I-10 in Benson (711 N Madison St), a convenient overnight stop near Kartchner Caverns and Tombstone. ~36 full-hookup sites (water/sewer/30-50 amp), big-rig and pet friendly, newly remodeled restrooms/showers, laundry, rec room; ~$55/night with weekly/monthly rates. Reservable by phone/online. Some interstate traffic noise. --Claude

name: Putter's Paradise RV Park
fees_note: $71.50 with all services.
note: Full-hookup RV park (30/50 amp) beside the Snowflake Golf Course in the White Mountains; ~89 sites, big-rig/pull-through, clubhouse, pool/hot tub, laundry. Accepts nightly transients (daily $71.50) as well as weekly/monthly; all ages. Reservable via the park directly. --Claude

name: Dwell Lake Havasu
fees_note: Full hookup from $79 (back-in) to $149 (premium pull-in).
note: New (2026) all-ages RV & glamping resort on Oatman Hwy near Topock; 164 full-hookup pull-through RV sites planned (~37 open in the initial phase) plus 20 casita cabins; resort pool/hot tub, bathhouse, pickleball, fitness center, clubhouse, dog park. Nightly and long-term stays; reservable online. Set ~3 mi from the Colorado River. --Claude

name: Woods Valley Kampground & RV Park
fees_note: Water, 30/20A and sewer $65 daily for 4 people; tents $40 (2-night minimum, Fri-Sat only).
note: Wooded family RV park & campground in Valley Center (San Diego backcountry); ~57 RV sites (full/partial hookup, RVs to 45 ft) plus tent area, pull-thrus, pool, on-site catch-and-release pond, laundry, hot showers, dump; nightly/weekly, reserve by phone. --Claude

name: Rio Del Sol RV Haven
fees_note: Daily $65 with electric, two-night minimum.
note: Full-hookup (30/50-amp) RV park on the Colorado River ~7 mi south of Parker, AZ; ~104 drive-in sites, boat launch, docks, swim beach, laundry/showers; big-rig friendly, reservable. --Claude

name: The Palms River Resort
fees_note: Plus tax: $55 regular, $60 weekends, $75 holidays.
note: Gated RV resort and manufactured-home community on Needles Hwy near the Colorado River; ~80 full-hookup RV sites (big-rig friendly, RVs to 80 ft), pool/spa, clubhouse, laundry, private beach/boat ramp with river access; takes nightly/weekly transients alongside long-term residents. --Claude

name: Rosedale Village RV Park
fees_note: Daily $62 ($58 seniors and clubs).
note: Private RV park at 13901 Rosedale Hwy (Hwy 58), Bakersfield, between the 99 and I-5. Mostly full-time residents but keeps ~8-10 gravel pull-through full-hookup sites for overnighters; big-rig friendly with concrete patios, pool, laundry, showers. Reservable by phone. --Claude

name: Mission Farm RV Park
fees_note: Full-hookup 30A pull-throughs $90 a night (RVs to ~42 ft).
note: Private RV park in San Juan Bautista off CA-156, ~1/2 mi from Mission San Juan Bautista. 140 full-hookup sites shaded by large redwoods, RVs to ~33 ft; restrooms, showers, WiFi; reservable year-round. --Claude

name: Kit Fox RV Park
fees_note: With tax: back-ins $64.99, pull-throughs $75; 10% and military discounts.
note: Transient RV park just off I-5 in Patterson (Central Valley travel stop); ~145 full-hookup pull-through sites (50/30/20 amp), RVs to 65 ft, laundry, pool. Daily/weekly/monthly, reservable by phone. --Claude

name: Lighthouse Resort and Marina
fees_note: Tent and RV sites $80 a night, up to 8 people; major holidays $100.
note: 32-acre private RV resort & marina on Brannan Island in the Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta (151 Brannan Island Rd, Isleton). 100+ RV sites with full or partial (30/50-amp + water) hookups plus extended-stay sites, tent sites and rental cabins; waterfront restaurant, boat launch, store, pool. Reservable transient stays. --Claude

name: Camp Lotus
fees_note: RV camping from $76 for 1-3 people, plus a $7 reservation fee.
note: Private riverside campground on 23 acres along the South Fork American River in Lotus (whitewater rafting hub). 12 RV sites with water + electric (shared dump station) plus tent sites; flush toilets, hot showers. Reservations recommended; no dogs. --Claude

name: Greenhorn Campground
fees_note: Dry camping only: meadow $54, RV/tent $59.50, pine grove and cabana $65, panoramic $63, lakefront $89.50.
note: Privately owned campground on a northern arm of Rollins Lake, ~7 mi from Colfax (the lake itself is NID; this campground is independent). 79 sites on gravel/dirt pads across Lake Front, Rocky Point, Meadow, Pine Grove, Cabana and Wagon Wheel areas; RV-friendly but no full hookups or dump station. Boat launch, beach, store. Reservable online/by phone. --Claude

name: Green Acres RV Park
fees_note: 2026: $55-65 plus tax; no restrooms or showers.
note: Private RV park moments from downtown Redding just off I-5; ~50 full-hookup sites (30/50-amp, water, sewer, cable) among mature trees, RVs to 60 ft, WiFi, clubhouse, pool (no on-site restroom/shower). Good overnight stopover, reservable year-round. --Claude

name: Etna RV Park
fees_note: $59 a night for 2 people.
note: 44 paved full-hookup pull-through sites in Scott Valley (Siskiyou County), big-rig friendly with 20/30/50-amp, showers, laundry, store, dump station; reservable. --Claude

name: Parc Leslie Campground
fees_note: Nightly $70, Prime $75, Prime Plus $84; $3 a day environmental tax.
note: Large private campground on ~1,000 acres at Leslie Lake, Otter Lake (Pontiac, Outaouais); 206 drive-in sites in sectors A–F with full-service, 2-service and semi-service (30-amp) hookups, sand beach, boat rentals; big rigs welcome. Nightly transient rates $55–$84 plus weekly/monthly. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Camping Boréal
fees_note: 2-3 services 30/50A $70 plus taxes.
note: Private campground at Baie-Comeau (Côte-Nord), bordered by the Rivière-aux-Anglais, ~5 min from the Jardin des glaciers and ~8 min from the Baie-Comeau–Matane ferry. 201 sites (~65 for RVs), two- and three-service; swimming pool, water slides, restaurant, store. Open ~mid-May–end Sept. Reservable. --Claude

name: Flamboro Valley Camping Resort
fees_note: Plus tax: water + electric $72, full service $82; non-serviced $65; long weekends $5 more with a 3-night minimum.
note: Family-run resort in a valley north of Hamilton on Regional Rd 97. 91 overnight RV sites plus 40 overnight tenting and 25 wilderness sites alongside 178 seasonal; 206 sites with hydro/water/sewer and 74 with hydro+water, 30/50-amp, pull-thrus, big-rig friendly to 45 ft. Heated pool, wading pool, hot tub, splash park, catch-and-release pond. Open May 1-Oct 15; overnight rates ~$34 unserviced / $38 hydro+water / $43 full hookup. Reservable online or by phone. --Claude

name: North Shore RV Park
fees_note: 2026 from, family of 4: full-hookup 30A back-in $79 up to 50A premium dog site $129.
note: Family-run park on Weller's Bay (Lake Ontario) at Carrying Place, open May 1 to mid-October. 103 full-season sites plus 22 overnight RV sites and 3 rental units; 123 sites with water/electric/sewer to 50 amp, 9 pull-thrus, big-rig friendly with a listed 80 ft length limit. Boat launch, seasonal and short-term dock rentals and a fish-cleaning station on the bay; pool, playground, dog park, laundry. Reservable online or by phone. --Claude

name: Paris Springs Park
fees_note: 2026 plus HST: standard 30A + water $80; holiday weekends $325 for 3 nights; no tents.
note: Wooded campground on Kitchen School Rd a few minutes outside Paris in Brant County, roughly 150 sites laid out in loops around a spring-fed swimming pond, with a rec hall, live entertainment and walking paths. Predominantly seasonal sites, but the operator sells overnight camping at a nightly rate on standard sites with 30 amp power, water and weekly septic pump-out; weekly and monthly rates offered, three-night minimum on holiday weekends, and trailers, pop-ups and RVs only (no tents). Reservations by phone or online. --Claude

name: Riverwood Park
fees_note: Daily $80 with HST.
note: Family-owned since 1968 on the Scugog River just outside Lindsay; 300+ sites on 100 acres, all with 30- or 50-amp hydro. The park map splits inventory into a large seasonal block and two clearly-marked transient sections (transient water+electric and transient water/electric/sewer, roughly 75 sites incl. the lettered A-W block, B1-B8, 147-162, H1-H10, D1-D7, W1-W5 and 164-174), so real overnight inventory alongside the seasonal majority. Reservable by phone/online; 2026 posted overnight rate $80 CAD/night incl. tax, weekly $480, plus seasonal lots $3,610-$4,040. Boat docks, beach and two heated pools on site. --Claude

name: Saugeen Riverbank Campground
fees_note: Read on Campspot: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (creekside and riverside). October 2026: C$70 on a Wednesday. Later dates show no sites: the season has ended and next year's isn't open for booking yet. Plus the park's C$5 'Booking Fee', once per stay. Read 2026-10-13. The campground's 2026 rates page lists C$75 a night for a hydro-and-water site (sites 54 to 61, of which 57 to 61 are on the river), where Campspot charged C$70, and C$50 for an unserviced group site, left out here; rates are for 2 adults, with C$10 for each extra adult (up to 6 per site) and children 18 and under free.  HST is extra, and half is due at booking.
note: Campground on the Saugeen River, a fly-fishing mecca, near Walkerton.  It rents kayaks, canoes and river tubes, and a free shuttle drops tubers at Maple Hill Dam for a float of about 1.5 to 2 hours back to camp; there are a children's fishing pond and free pedal carts.  Through the season there are 50/50 draws, potlucks, barbecues, fishing derbies, bingo, paint nights, the annual river run and weekend fly-fishing schools.  Outside firewood is not allowed; the campground provides local bundled wood.  The Lake Huron beaches at Port Elgin and Kincardine are a 30-minute drive.  It also rents bunkies, a Mongolian yurt, biodomes with hot tubs and saunas and a 3-bedroom trailer. --Claude

name: Bates Beach Oceanfront Resort
fees_note: Oceanfront full hookup 30A $70; the $50-55 15A/water oceanfront sites take only 20-ft rigs.
note: Oceanfront resort on the Strait of Georgia just north of Courtenay; 40 full-hookup RV sites (30-amp, paved) including an oceanfront row, plus tenting; showers, laundry, kayak/paddleboat rental. Full-service from $55, oceanfront $70, 2-night min Jul-Aug, reservable. --Claude  MINIMUM STAY: 2 nights in July and August (batesbeach.bc.ca, 2026-10-12). --Claude

name: Fort Victoria RV Park & Campground
fees_note: Full hookups for 2 plus GST: $82 to May 31 2026, $85 from June 1.
note: Large year-round full-hookup RV park at 340 Island Hwy 1A near downtown Victoria; ~300 full-hookup sites (up to 50-amp) with 8 pull-thrus, washrooms/free showers, laundry, playground, RV supply shop, cable/WiFi. RV-only transient destination park (published nightly rate ~$85 CAD/2 people); off-season weekly/monthly available. --Claude

note: Big-rig full-hookup RV resort by Swan Lake N of Vernon; 30/50-amp full hookups, heated outdoor pool, hot tub, laundry, WiFi; daily/weekly/monthly transient stays. Real transient RV resort. --Claude

name: Orchard Valley RV Park
note: Small family-owned RV park on Rojem Rd in the orchard area near Kelowna, adjacent to (and distinct from) Orchard Hill RV Park. 10 sites, RVs only, 30/50-amp service and internet, fruit trees between sites with u-pick. --Claude

name: Coy Lake Camping and RV Park
fees_note: Full-hookup 30/50A pull-throughs $75 plus tax.
note: Small family park on Coy Lake at Upper Gagetown (Rte 102), ~20 min from Fredericton. ~49 fully serviced sites, 30/50-amp, water/sewer, pull-throughs, pool, dump station; nightly, monthly and seasonal rates, open May 15-Oct 15. Nightly transient sites confirmed. --Claude

name: Pine Cone Camping

note: Large RV-only park (no tents) on Route 114 midway between Saint John and Moncton; 292 sites incl 258 full-hookup and 10 pull-thrus, two heated pools, free WiFi; open May 1-Oct 10; daily rate ~$60 CAD plus seasonal. --Claude

name: Smith Point Marina
fees_note: Smith Point Marina: $75 a night for up to 4 people, electric, water and sewer; $550 a month. Read 2026-10-15.
note: Fisherman's campground inside a working marina on the Little Wicomico River, about a mile from the Chesapeake Bay and five miles from Reedville (989 Smith Point Rd). Small: the operator lists 5 camper sites with electricity, water and sanitary drain (two on concrete pads) to the right of the marina entrance, plus 10 centrally located seasonal hookup sites, and states all sites are available to transient campers; allstays counts 8 sites, rigs to 45 ft, season May through November. $75 per night for up to four people ($5 per extra person), $550 monthly. RV only - no tenting, open fires or fireworks. Reservations required; call the marina. Boat ramp, slips, ships store and charter fleet on site. RV Life 5*/$$ ~$34/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude

name: Saunderosa Park
fees_note: Saunderosa: water/electric/sewer $65 a day for a family of 4, $75 on holiday and event weekends; $442.50 a week. Read 2026-10-15.
note: Family-run since 1958 on 320 acres in the Little Cove Valley at 5909 Little Cove Road, between two mountains and surrounded by state game lands. Operator's official 2025 site map shows roughly 300 numbered sites in two colour classes - yellow seasonal lots and salmon 20/30/50-amp water/electric/sewer sites - plus a handful of cabins, an in-ground pool, mini-golf, pickleball and a catch-and-release lake. Operator's own Camping Rates page publishes daily $65, weekly $442.50 and monthly $1,100 (all W/E/S), with holiday/special-event weekends $75 and a 3-night minimum on Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day; check-in and check-out both 2:00pm, $5/day per visiting guest, published cancellation policy. Contact page states the park 'serves mostly as a visiting campground' while also home to some permanent residents; the separate Seasonal page runs Apr 25-Oct 26 with lot rent due Apr 15. Reservable online through the operator's Book Now portal or by phone. Aggregator listings still quote a stale $26-34/night - the operator's own page is $65. Big-rig friendly (listed to 50 ft) with pull-throughs, dump station, laundry and RV storage. RV Life 4*/$$ ~$39/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude

name: Sturgis RV Park
fees_note: RV daily $60 plus tax (May 15-Jul 29, Aug 16-Sep 6); rally rates separate.
note: In-town park on W Woodland Drive, walking distance to Sturgis' Main Street. 152 full-hookup 30/50-amp sites, 110 on concrete pads, each with a picnic table and a loading dock for motorcycles; dog and bike wash, free wifi, parcel handling. Good Sam Park with a military discount. Priced above the sweep's usual private gate. RV Life 4.5*/$$$ (auto 9/2026)

name: Kool Lakes Family RV Park
fees_note: Kool Lakes: water/electric $60 a day, water/electric/sewer $65, for a family of 4. Read 2026-10-15.
note: Large family campground near Garrettsville (Portage Co) with three spring-fed lakes - a 1.5-acre swimming lake with sandy beach and two fishing lakes; mostly seasonal, but water/electric and full-hookup pull-through sites are sold nightly (2026: W/E $60, W/E/S $65 for a family of four; one-night deposit, 2-night deposit on holiday weekends). Season May 1-Oct 15. Free swimming and fishing for campers. RV Life 4*/$$ ~$33/night (auto 9/2026); Google 4.2 over 260 reviews. --Claude

name: Woods-N-Waters Kampground
fees_note: Read on Campspot: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (20/30/50 Amp Water/Electric Back-In, 20/30/50 Amp Water/Electric Pull-Through, 30 Amp Water/Electric Back-In, 30 Amp Water/Electric Pull-Through, 50 Amp Water/Electric Back-In and 3 more). A cancellation more than 30 days ahead is refunded less a $25 fee, one 15-30 days ahead earns a credit, and holiday deposits aren't refunded.

Booked online, one-day deposit per week. Season 7 May-Thanksgiving Monday. --Claude
